title: Amarillo Project
description: Amarillo/Rojo project file format — describes how the instance tree maps to the filesystem.

name.description: The name of the project, displayed in Amarillo and Rojo.
name.title: Project Name

extends.title: Extends Project
extends.description: Relative path to another .project.json used as the base for this project.

abstract.title: Abstract Project
abstract.description: If true, this project can be inherited by others but is not selectable directly for sync.

host.title: Serve Host
host.description: Set the host that the sync server should be running on.

port.title: Serve Port
port.description: Set the port that the sync server should be running on.

gameId.title: Game ID
gameId.description: Limit clients to only sync with this project when the game ID matches.

placeIds.title: Place IDs
placeIds.description: Limit clients to only sync with this project when one of the place IDs matches.

ignoreGlobs.title: Ignore Globs
ignoreGlobs.description: Exclude files that match any of these globs from processing and syncing.

syncRules.title: Sync Rules
syncRules.description: Replace the default sync rules with a custom set of user-defined sync rules.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of file this rule applies to.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: A glob pattern that matches the file path.

childPattern.title: Child Pattern
childPattern.description: A glob pattern that matches folder-contained file path.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: A list of glob patterns that exclude the file path from this rule.

suffix.title: Suffix
suffix.description: A suffix to strip from the file path to get the instance name.

syncback.title: Syncback Settings
syncback.description: Customize how instances are synced back to the file system.

ignoreGlobs.title: Ignore Globs
ignoreGlobs.description: Exclude files matching these globs from syncback processing.

ignoreNames.title: Ignore Names
ignoreNames.description: Exclude instances with these names from syncback.

ignoreClasses.title: Ignore Classes
ignoreClasses.description: Exclude instances with these class names from syncback.

ignoreProperties.title: Ignore Properties
ignoreProperties.description: Exclude these properties from being saved to the file system.

legacyScripts.title: Legacy Scripts
legacyScripts.description: Use legacy Script/LocalScript class names instead of RunContext-based scripts.

$path.description: The path on the filesystem to map this instance to.

$properties.description: Properties to apply to this instance.

$keepUnknowns.description: If true, instances not described in this tree are kept (not deleted).

$amarilloDisabledPath.description: Amarillo internal path backup used when a place sync base mount is disabled and later restored.
